title: fix(ci): repair auth wrapper and unused helper exports
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Repairs the uncovered deadcode and wrapper-shadowing failures from scheduled main CI 38908699969 and the live deadcode scan on c3798aeb0892.

## User Impact

No runtime behavior changes. The public `applyProviderAuthConfigPatch` SDK name and signature remain intact. The provider index gains a link to the existing oMLX guide.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Delete the unused AI transport redactor left behind by #174217’s intentional content-free diagnostics change.
- Give the internal auth patch normalizer a distinct name and update its internal callers; retain the SDK’s narrower auth-result contract and existing header-deletion/model-merge semantics from #173327.
- Keep the Ollama context threshold, Nostr relay fixture, and Talk SQL observer private to their owners. Delete the unreferenced Crabbox inspect-case builder left after #174210.

The oMLX labeler fix landed in #174277. The unused i18n controller, test, and barrel deletion is covered by active #174263. This PR does not duplicate either peer change. No ignores, baselines, assertions, timeouts, retries, or dependencies change.

## Evidence

- Before: wrapper-shadowing fails; the three Knip scans report six distinct unused exports. After: full-tree and scripts scans are clean, and production reports only `I18nController`, covered by #174263.
- `pnpm test` with `--maxWorkers=1`: 102 owner cases in 7 files pass (247.39s wall); all 532 cases in 31 affected shared-helper importer files pass (445.57s wall). Existing assertions are retained.
- `pnpm check:architecture` passes (299.23s), including the wrapper guard; the complete source-contract lane passes (131.15s).
- Core, auth, command, package, extension, and Talk owning typecheck lanes pass; Ollama package types pass after refreshing stale local SDK declarations. Targeted lint, boundary lint, formatting, and independent P2 review pass.

The initial Ollama check used stale generated SDK declarations and reported missing current model fields/exports. Canonical lint preparation regenerated them; the same package check then passed. A separate explicit preparation attempt named Crabbox, which has no package tsconfig, and exited without preparing it. No source or policy workaround was added. Broad PR CI remains the hosted proof; this branch deliberately does not claim the two peer-owned fixes.
